diagnostic_plan.kind: short diagnostic; not original acceptance campaign
stop_rules: CPU usage above 80 percent of quota or throttled time above 10 percent of observation window
generator sampled CPU or memory above 80 percent of host capacity

smoke.transport: local Caddy HTTPS; fixed loopback socket, public hostname/SNI

interpretation: Latency summaries are medians/ranges of per-run p95 values, never pooled percentiles or confidence intervals.
Full-window SQL/CPU per verified cycle includes browser initialization, warmup, final reads, background work and observers.

The reviewed workload records latency only for operations completing inside the measured window; crossing-boundary cycles remain correctness-checked. Short windows are more sensitive to this censoring.
Closed workload throughput is not an equal-offered-rate headroom comparison.
No supported-capacity claim: the remaining contention, volume and longer-duration matrix must pass.
Backend/lock/CPU samples are periodic observations, not peak occupancy or Ecto connection lease measurements. Idle controls include observer cost and are not subtracted from workload totals.

measured_phase_cpu_samples.interpretation: Sparse Docker CPU observations; neither continuous utilization nor exact peaks. PostgreSQL backend states do not measure Ecto connection leases.
